The preliminary proposal assumes financing 90% of eligible invoices, with ordinary supplier recourse and no special funding or screening controls. Before I make any decision on whether this facility may launch and on what operating terms, I'd like to conduct our standard round-robin review. I'd like to hear from credit risk, legal, and finance operations in turn. Could each of you share your assessment of this proposal? Let's start with credit risk.
